en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a European hill town. A large medieval hilltop castle complex with thick walls and simple gabled roofs dominates the left and center, rising above dense trees. A distinctive round tower with a crenellated, conical‑roofed top stands near the middle of the castle. Down the slope to the right lies a compact town with steep‑roofed houses and a tall Gothic-style church with a slender spire. In the foreground are cultivated fields or vineyards with several small human figures working among the rows.
